Major Bludd is an evil character in the G.I. Joe: Renegades cartoon series.

Key threads from this canonical page lead to G.I. Joe, Major Bludd, Major Bludd, Major Bludd, Baroness and Baroness. Each link is another long-tail path through the subject.

How Major Bludd connects

These mapped links are unique to this page — each one is another long-tail route through the subject graph.

  • Topic: G.I. Joe — Part of
  • Character: Major Bludd — Major Bludd's entry mentions Major Bludd — There are many things that Major Bludd is known for. He is known for his despicability and greed. It is said that he would willingly rent out his grandmother as a tackling dummy.
  • Character: Major Bludd — Major Bludd's entry mentions Major Bludd — Sebastian Bludd also known as Major Bludd is a mercenary working for the terrorist organisation Cobra. He makes a cameo in the opening sequence of G.I. Joe: Retaliation.
  • Character: Major Bludd — Major Bludd's entry mentions Major Bludd — Major Bludd is the first Cobra, and the first character, who dies in G.I. Joe Resolute. Likely, when he was alive had a similar function and personality as his ARAH counterpart.
  • Character: Baroness — Major Bludd's entry mentions Baroness — Anastasia Cisarovna, also known as Baroness, is a femme fatale and a corporate saboteur who serves as Cobra Commander's right hand woman.
  • Character: Baroness — Major Bludd's entry mentions Baroness — The Baroness serves as the Cobra's intelligence officer and lieutenant to Cobra Commander. She is a dark, sensual femme fatale whose beauty is matched only by her ruthlessness.
  • Character: Baroness — Major Bludd's entry mentions Baroness — The Baroness seduced Sheik Mommar al Rhazidh and was invited back to his home. Once there, she drugged him, evaded his security personnel, and stole a map that led M.A.R.S.
  • Character: Baroness — Major Bludd's entry mentions Baroness — Baroness is portrayed by Úrsula Corberó.

Major Bludd is an evil character in the G.I. Joe: Renegades cartoon series.
